customStyles.namePlaceholder: Give it a name — that is how you see it on the card
customStyles.promptPlaceholder:
Paste the full visual style here (it is the model's system prompt).

Describe how the images look: line, colors, light, framing, era, character.

If you want DYNAMISM, ask for it explicitly and as an obligation, not a suggestion:
  · "Every prompt must start with one of these shots: ..."
  · "Never repeat the same shot twice in a row."
  · "Change location when the narration moves somewhere else."
  · "Text drawn in the image goes in the script's language."

Image prompts always come out in English (the generator only reads English): do not ask the style to write in another language.

A permission is not an instruction: whatever you want to happen, write it as an obligation.

export.help: Generates one clip per scene (with its exact duration) + the audio, so you can edit them in CapCut or Premiere without losing sync.

editor.regenFailed: Some scenes could not be regenerated: see the reason on each scene; their previous image is kept.
editor.missingImagesHint: Tap an empty scene in the timeline and use "Regenerate" to create its image: it is illustrated from its narration or, if nothing is said in that stretch, from the neighbouring lines — or write a description if you want something else. Once they all have one, build your video.
editor.demoLocked: In the demo, images and narration come from the sample package: they cannot be regenerated.
editor.animationFailed: Some scenes could not be animated: they stay static with the usual pan, and the reason is in the notice.

animationFailure.title: Some animations could not be completed
animationFailure.body: Your images and previous clips were preserved. You can retry the listed scenes.

animationRange.title: Animate the beginning of the video
animationRange.hint: Generate the missing clips in this range. Completed animations are preserved and the rest of the video keeps its timing.
animationRange.invalidScenes: This range contains scenes outside the supported limits. Adjust their cuts before animating.

animationDialog.move: Move window (or use the arrow keys)

transitions.label: Add crossfades between images

transitions.playHint: Play the video to preview the transitions.

imageGallery.label: Expanded image view
imageGallery.description_one: {{count}} scene. Regenerate images or animate clips without leaving this gallery.
imageGallery.description_other: {{count}} scenes. Regenerate images or animate clips without leaving this gallery.
imageGallery.reviewHint: You will go to its description in the editor. There you can edit the prompt and confirm regeneration.
imageGallery.locked: Demo project images cannot be regenerated.
imageGallery.promptHint: Want something different? Describe it here. To use the existing image prompt, leave the description unchanged and click “Regenerate image”.
imageGallery.selectionHint: Select scenes to regenerate their images or animate their clips in one step.
imageGallery.browseHint: Select an image to regenerate or animate it. Use “Select” to work with several.
imageGallery.queueGenerating: Generating this image. When it finishes, we will move to the next selected scene.
imageGallery.queueFailed: This image did not complete. Retry with “Regenerate image” or skip to the next scene.
imageGallery.queueHint: Edit the description or regenerate with the existing prompt. Only the scene you confirm will be generated.
imageGallery.queueAnimationFailed: The animation did not complete. Check the panel notice to resume, retry, or skip to the next scene.
imageGallery.queueAnimationHint: Review the clip’s scenes, duration, and credits before confirming its animation. Then we will move to the next one.
imageGallery.queueImagePass: Step 1 of 2 · Review the selected images first. Their animations come next.
imageGallery.queueAnimationPass: Step 2 of 2 · Confirm each animation in the panel. A clip may cover multiple scenes.
imageGallery.queueRecoveryRequired: An animation needs recovery. Resume it in the panel before changing its image to preserve the work already requested.
imageGallery.queueRefreshFailed: The result was saved, but we could not refresh the view. Continue the review to read it again without repeating generation.
imageGallery.endReviewHint: Close the review. Generations in progress will continue.
imageGallery.descriptionPlaceholder: What would you like to change in this image?
imageGallery.descriptionHint: Write a description for a different result. If there are no pending changes, leaving it empty reuses the current prompt.
imageGallery.pendingDescriptionHint: A description change is pending. Regenerating will apply it; you can write here to replace it. Leaving this empty does not discard the saved change.
imageGallery.submitFailed: We could not start. Your selection and descriptions were kept.
imageGallery.recoveringImage: Resume the pending animation before changing its image.
imageGallery.imagesFirst: Regenerate these images first, or close the descriptions to animate the current images.
imageGallery.noImageProvider: Configure an image provider key before regenerating.
imageGallery.insufficientCredits: The available balance is not enough for this selection.
imageGallery.shortPairHint: 3-second scenes: animating one includes the next compatible scene to create a 6-second clip. Pairs are shown here before you start. Without a pair, only that clip is adjusted to its duration.
imageGallery.undoHint_one: To change the images, undo the animation first. Then you can regenerate them. This clip covers {{count}} scene.
imageGallery.undoHint_other: To change the images, undo the animation first. Then you can regenerate them. This clip covers {{count}} scenes.
imageGallery.undoBeforeImages: To change the images, undo the animation first. Then you can regenerate them.

license.tagline: Your account status and current plan.
license.planActivoDescripcion: You have full access to {{nombre}} with no restrictions. Thanks for supporting the project!
license.accesoBetaDescripcion: While the beta lasts you can use {{nombre}} with no time limit and no charge. We'll let you know before anything changes.

costs.disclaimer: Prices may change based on each provider's current rates (Fal.ai, Evolink, DubVoice). This catalog reflects prices at the last Vimo update. If you spot a different value, let us know.
costs.tituloVideo: How much each video costs you
costs.tituloImagenes: How much each image costs you
costs.tituloVoces: How much each audio costs you
costs.subtituloVideo: Mix image provider + voice and see total cost for 5/10/20 min.
costs.subtituloImagenes: Compare Fal vs Evolink batch by batch (40 / 220 / 446 images).
costs.subtituloVoces: 1 credit = 1 character in DubVoice, with Minimax, Vbee or Fish Audio. Linear cost based on script length.
costs.notaVideo: * Estimates: narration at ~150 words/min (≈13 chars/sec) · ~1 scene every 7s.
costs.notaImagenes: Columns 40 / 220 / 446 are reference figures for short / medium / long videos.
costs.notaVoces: 1 credit = 1 character. Linear pricing: $11.90 per 1,000,000 characters.

catalogo.cuadrado: Square. Cropped to 16:9 (loses a lot of image).
catalogo.sunoCreditos: ~50–200 credits per generation (varies by model and song length).
catalogo.sunoNotas: Generates 2 variations per call so you pick your favorite. Models: suno-v5-beta (recommended) and suno-v4.5plus-beta. You can choose instrumental or with vocals. Download links are valid for 72 hours.

characters.tagline: your cast, consistent in every video
characters.intro: A character stores a style-neutral identity: who they are, not how they are drawn. That is why the same character looks consistent in any video style.
characters.soloEscritorio: Characters are stored in your projects folder: this screen works in the desktop app.

vacio.titulo: You don't have any characters yet
vacio.texto: Create your first one: describe who they are and AI writes their identity so they look the same across your videos.

modal.descripcion: Describe who the character is. The identity is reused across all your videos.

identity.textNotice: Without photo: cheaper (no extra cost per image). The character stays consistent through its description, but the build may vary slightly between scenes.

photo.descriptionPlaceholder: Description (hair, features, usual outfit). Optional, but it helps consistency.
photo.notice: Important: the photo must show the character only, no background. It comes out more consistent, but costs ~2× per image.

filter.emptyPhoto: You don't have any characters with a photo yet.
filter.emptyText: You don't have any characters without a photo yet.

form.descripcionPlaceholder: Hair, features, clothing and colors that make them recognizable.
form.descripcionHint: Describe who they are, never the drawing style: the style is chosen when you generate each video.

experto.ayuda: AI rewrites the identity in English, ordered by the most recognizable traits.
experto.completaCampos: Fill in name, age, role and some notes so AI can write the identity.
experto.faltaClave: You need a DeepInfra key to use AI.

preview.titulo: See how it would look — generate a preview per style
preview.nota: These previews are stored with the character. Build may vary slightly between scenes.
preview.vacio: You haven't generated any preview yet.
preview.faltaClave: You need the key for the selected provider.
preview.customStyleNote: With a custom style, your gem writes the portrait prompt (one AI call, needs DeepInfra) and then the image is generated.
preview.sinEstilosPropios: You don't have custom styles in your gallery yet.

apiKeys.opcionalesDescripcion: Alternative providers: one configured key per category is enough.

descripcion.deepinfra: Main AI: generates the visual prompts for each scene.
descripcion.fal: Images with gpt-image. The key must be Admin type.
descripcion.evolink: Images with gpt-image (pricier, more realistic). The same key works for AI music.

descripcion.poyo: Animates a scene with Veo. Optional, only if you want animated scenes.

settings.errorNoEscribible: That folder is not writable. Pick another one.

settings.sceneDurationTagline: The pace your My style videos start with
